Which statement explains why stainless steel is used to make cutlery?
A
It is softer than the pure metal.
B
It is more resistant to rusting than the pure metal.
C
It is an alloy made of copper and zinc.
D
It is more ductile than the pure metal.

options.label: A
options.text: It is softer than the pure metal.

options.label: B
options.text: It is more resistant to rusting than the pure metal.

options.label: C
options.text: It is an alloy made of copper and zinc.

options.label: D
options.text: It is more ductile than the pure metal.
